extraction_scope.scope: single explicit official flow run directory

source.derivation: Actual published archive source bytes also equal every frozen RTL hash and the identified Git commit

qualification.reason: Measurement extraction only; the separate attempt ledger must verify eligibility, official precheck, routed functional tests, exact source correspondence and closure.

limitations: A state_out file is published state, not proof of job success.
Final metrics presence does not establish completed workflow or physical qualification.
Unfinished stage measurements and timing reports retain their actual stage identity.
Zero-delay routed simulation and STA are distinct checks; missing values are unavailable.
